name: COSMOS at UC Irvine (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science)
what_you_do: You live on campus for four weeks. You take a hands-on, lab-heavy STEM course. It is called a cluster. Faculty, researchers and scientists teach it.
who_can_apply: California high school students in grades 8 to 12, per the COSMOS application site. A GPA of 3.5 or above is typical.
pay_detail: Fee-based residential program. The 2027 cost is not stated on UCI's page, so check the COSMOS site for the current fee.
deadline_text: Statewide COSMOS dates: application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027. Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027. UCI holds info sessions in December.
how_to_apply: Online application with a personal statement, teacher recommendation(s), transcripts and a parent or guardian e-signature, plus the application fee. You choose one campus and cluster.
notes: Competitive. UCI's own pages still show 2026 details, so the statewide site is the source for the 2027 dates. Students must live on campus for the full program. COSMOS runs on several UC campuses. This card is the UC Irvine campus.
